description: Use this when a guest wants the wedding website or the registry of a couple that the guest knows. Give the first and last name of one partner, and the name of the other partner or the year and month of the wedding. Gives the links of one couple only, from the couples who let guests find them on zola.com. When no single couple matches, gives the zola.com couple search and no names. Do not use to list couples, to browse registries, or to find a person who is not getting married.

first_partner.description: The first and last name of one partner

second_partner.description: The name of the other partner

wedding_month.description: The year and month of the wedding, YYYY-MM, for example 2027-06. Necessary when second_partner is not given

name: zola_find_couple

names_on_zola.description: With found_close_names only: the Zola spelling of the names that the user gave

search_url.description: With not_found: the zola.com couple search for the names given

status.description: found: one couple with the names given. found_close_names: one couple with names that are near the names given, which the user must make sure of. not_found: no single couple matches, so use search_url

wedding_month.description: The month of the wedding, for example 'June 2027'

title: Find a Couple on Zola
